artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\alpha\in\mathbb{R}$. Denote by $\mathbb{D}=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:|z|<1\}$ the open unit disk and let $\mathbb{D}'=\mathbb{D}\setminus\{0\}$. Let
$$f(z)=z+\sum_{n=2}^{\infty}a_n z^n$$
be analytic in $\mathbb{D}$ with $f(z)f'(z)/z\neq 0$ for $z\in\mathbb{D}'$. The function $f$ is said to belong to the class $M_\alpha$ of $\alpha$-convex functions if
$$\operatorname{Re}\left[(1-\alpha)\,\frac{zf'(z)}{f(z)}+\alpha\!\left(1+\frac{zf''(z)}{f'(z)}\right)\right]>0\qquad\text{for all }|z|<1.$$
Note that $M_0=S^*$ (starlike functions) and $M_1=K$ (convex functions), and it is known that $M_\alpha\subset S^*$ for every real $\alpha$.

It is known that:
\begin{enumerate}
\item[(a)] If $\sum_{n=2}^{\infty} n\,|a_n|\le 1$, then $f\in M_0$.
\item[(b)] If $\sum_{n=2}^{\infty} n^2\,|a_n|\le 1$, then $f\in M_1$.
\end{enumerate}

Find a coefficient condition on the sequence $\{a_n\}_{n\ge 2}$, depending on $\alpha$ and reducing to (a) when $\alpha=0$ and to (b) when $\alpha=1$, that is sufficient to guarantee $f\in M_\alpha$.
artifact.status_search_result: Various sufficient coefficient conditions for subclasses of α-convex functions (and α-convex functions of order β) have been published using the Miller–Mocanu lemma and related techniques. However, no single canonical generalization unifying the two stated bounds for all real α appears to be definitively established as the answer to this specific problem; literature shows multiple partial sufficient conditions rather than a settled solution.

status_evidence.title: Some sufficient conditions for alpha convex functions of order beta
status_evidence.snippet: Sufficient conditions for the class H(α,n,β) of alpha convex functions of order β are derived via Mocanu-type lemmas.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results: various sufficient conditions for α-convex (sub)classes have been obtained.

status_evidence.title: Coefficient problem for alpha-convex univalent functions
status_evidence.snippet: Coefficient bounds for α-convex univalent functions in the unit disk.
status_evidence.claim: Coefficient theory for M_α has been developed but a unified sufficient coefficient condition matching (a) and (b) is not singled out.
